- We want to add a premium latency SLO for the US region: p99 < 300ms and p99.9 < 600ms for text generation traffic (steady-state). Is that feasible as an addendum?

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front, more detail below:

- We can deliver a premium latency band close to what you proposed; p99 < 300ms is achievable on a dedicated pool with the right batching/quantization profile. p99.9 will depend on tail behavior for peak prefix lengths; we typically set p99.9 targets with a sequence-length carve-out.
- We can reserve regional capacity (US-west preferred). We support a mixed model: base committed capacity (reserved GPUs) + burst pool for seasonality.
- Named oncall roster and a written escalation SLA are standard for premium support. We’ll provide a 24x7 oncall roster with primary + backup and documented incident timelines.

I’ve attached a first-pass SLO addendum (SLO_addendum_draft.pdf) that captures target metrics, credit structures, and proposed monitoring hooks. It also includes an example canary/onramp plan (4-week phased ramp).

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You + Procurement review the draft addendum (we'll iterate).
2) Confirm committed baseline and preferred burst window sizing (we'll model cost).
3) We schedule a technical ops walkthrough w/ our SREs (30–45 min).

I’ll loop Marissa for pricing and Rishi for contractual flow once we have baseline numbers. Can you confirm availability for a quick call tomorrow (2026-08-13) 11:00–11:30 PT?

—Marcus Lin
